rationale: Description: 'Bend one arm, resting the hand on the hip, and extend the other arm to touch the knee. Posture straight with arched back.' Per protocol §4 INSTRUCTIONS are ground truth. (1) LEFT hand on hip: leftShoulder -90→75 (coronal abduction out to side ~horizontal, not overhead; per convention - = raise up, + = abduction out), shoulderFwdL 12→0 (no fwd/back, pure coronal abduction), leftElbow 60→90 (right-angle bend, hand to hip). (2) RIGHT hand on knee: rightShoulder -15→0 (no abduction, arm in sagittal plane), shoulderFwdR 15→-70 (forward reach per corrected - = forward), rightElbow 10→40 (slight flex, forearm down to knee). (3) globalTwist 5→0 (no twist mentioned). (4) neck -6→0 (no side tilt; 'face toward camera' = yaw not modeled). Sweep flag 'hands_on_hips' (plural) is false positive — only one hand on hip per description. Rig limitation: hand-to-knee contact partial (arm length vs shoulder-to-knee distance).
